## Format compliance (standards/skill-format.md)
- [ ] SKILL.md frontmatter complete per schema
- [ ] Canonical section order (validator enforces)
- [ ] INPUT → PROCESS → OUTPUT → VALIDATION structure
- [ ] When NOT to Use + Failure Modes included
- [ ] ≥3 test cases in skills/<name>/tests/ (≥1 designed to fail a bad run)
- [ ] Duplicate/overlap check against existing skills
- [ ] quality block scored honestly

## Status
New skills start `status: experimental` — promotion requires a recorded real-world run.
